implement_env_reset: implement a subclass of Env that resets the environment to its initial state
implement_env_apply_action: implement a subclass of Env that applies an Action and optionally uses info and prev_obs
implement_env_get_observation: implement a subclass of Env that returns current Observations from the environment
implement_env_episode_over: implement a subclass of Env with an episode_over property that returns whether the episode has ended
implement_env_get_episode_metrics: implement a subclass of Env that returns a dictionary of metrics for the current episode
